outcome: A creature card can be cast from hand only in a main phase of its controller's turn with an empty stack.
A resolving creature spell moves to the battlefield under its controller's control.
A creature deals combat damage equal to its power.
A creature with damage marked at least equal to its toughness is destroyed.
A creature's power and toughness are its printed values modified by applicable continuous effects.
Creatures are legal attackers and blockers when no other restriction applies.
A creature not controlled continuously since its controller's turn began cannot attack or activate tap-symbol or untap-symbol abilities.
Damage from a source without wither or infect is marked, lethal damage destroys the creature, and marked damage is removed on regeneration and in cleanup.
